item.text: The action buttons currently wait for confirmation before calling `startUpdating`, and their operation promises are detached from the handlers. I’m moving the lock to `RoomAdminToolsContainer`, where it can disable all three controls for this member synchronously, and keeping it held across the dialog and the awaited request.

The shared lock is now wired through the admin tools, including synchronous duplicate-call protection and disabled/ARIA-disabled rendering. The focused `UserInfo` Jest suite is still running; once it finishes I’ll check formatting/types and review the resulting diff.

Implemented a member-scoped lock for Kick, Ban/Unban, and Mute/Unmute in [UserInfo.tsx](/app/src/components/views/right_panel/UserInfo.tsx). It disables all three controls with `disabled` and `aria-disabled="true"` before showing confirmation, and releases the lock after cancellation or when the request settles. The existing error dialogs handle request failures.

The focused `UserInfo` suite passed: 68 tests. ESLint and `git diff --check` passed. TypeScript checking reported existing SDK and unrelated-file errors; it reported none in the edited file.
